review.note: Retracted in M41b: the largest Portuguese telecommunications provider, founded in 1994 and a wholly owned subsidiary of Altice since June 2015. The atlas holds no record of the privatisation of Portugal Telecom, of the liberalisation of the fixed market in 2000, or of the sale to Altice, which are the three events this company would be joined by. Nothing here can be argued to follow from it or to have produced it.
